meta.title: Screenshot & annotate
meta.description: Windows slim builds ship without a screenshot tool. This plugin adds capture and annotation to DeepSeek Harness: press Ctrl+Alt+Q or click the camera at the left of the composer, a native full-screen window opens, select a region, mark it up with rectangles, ellipses, arrows, a pen, text or mosaic, and press Enter to insert the selection into the composer as a draft attachment (it is not sent). A copy button puts it on the clipboard instead. It brings its own capture and does not depend on the system screenshot tool; the capture surface is a separate Win32/GDI window, not a page overlay, so there is no title bar in the way and your window is never resized. 'Hide this window' makes the camera minimize the Harness window first; the shortcut captures the screen as-is and puts the result on the clipboard. Windows only.
